personal_info.name: Daniel Okafor
personal_info.summary: Backend engineer with 4 years of experience designing and scaling Java/Spring Boot microservices handling millions of daily transactions. Strong in API design, relational data modeling, and system reliability.

experience.title: Backend Engineer
responsibilities: Designed and built REST APIs in Java/Spring Boot for the booking-payments service handling 2M+ requests/day
Migrated a monolith payment module into an independently deployable microservice, cutting deploy time from 40 to 8 minutes
Optimized PostgreSQL queries and added composite indexes, reducing p99 latency by 35%
Introduced contract testing between services using Pact, catching breaking changes before release

experience.title: Software Engineer I
responsibilities: Built internal REST services in Java and Spring Boot for job-listing search infrastructure
Wrote JUnit test suites achieving 85% coverage on core service modules
Set up Kafka consumers to process listing-update events at scale

projects.name: Task Queue Service
description: Built a lightweight distributed task queue in Java backed by PostgreSQL and Redis
Supported at-least-once delivery and exponential backoff retries
